classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Pages 41–42 define the empty set and subsets; this singleton has two subsets.

content.prompt:
Given a set $X$, its $\mathit{power\ set}$, $\mathcal P(X)$, is the set containing all subsets of $X$. Write down $\mathcal P(X)$ for
$$X=\{p\}.$$

answer.worked:
The subsets are the empty set and $\{p\}$. Thus
$$\mathcal P(X)=\{\varnothing,\{p\}\}.$$
